title: A SWI/SNF complex-related genes signature predicts prognosis and immune infiltration in ccRCC with KCNK5 as a novel biomarker.
authors: Xu, Kai; Yan, Zhiwei; Liu, Yunxun; Qiu, Qiangmin; Ni, Xinmiao; Tang, Hao; Wang, Lei; Chen, Zhiyuan; Liu, Xiuheng
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用SWI/SNF染色质重塑复合物相关基因构建肾透明细胞癌预后模型并验证KCNK5功能，属于纯临床预后与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) is the most common subtype of renal cell carcinoma (RCC). Although we have made many achievements in the therapy of RCC with the progress of medicine, the clinical management of metastatic RCC remains a daunting challenge. SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex-related genes (SCRGs) are significantly associated with tumor progression and cancer cell evolution in ccRCC. This study aimed to investigate the prognostic significance of SCRGs in ccRCC to elucidate its molecular subtype characteristics. Using 29 known SCRGs, 532 ccRCC patients from the TCGA-KIRC cohort were classified into two subtypes (SCRGcluster A and SCRGcluster B). Patients in SCRGcluster B exhibited a significantly poorer prognosis compared to those in SCRGcluster A. Functional enrichment and immune microenvironment profiles significantly differed between the subtypes, with SCRGcluster B showing higher levels of immune infiltration. Five core genes (TMCC3, TOP2A, EPS8, PIK3R3, KCNK5) were identified through the integration of multiple machine learning approaches and multivariate Cox regression analysis. A novel prognostic model based on these core genes was validated in an external cohort. Additionally, single-cell data analysis revealed the expression patterns of these core genes in ccRCC. In vitro experiments demonstrated that KCNK5 is underexpressed in ccRCC cell lines and tissues, and that its overexpression suppresses malignant phenotypes. Specifically, KCNK5 overexpression significantly inhibited the proliferation, migration, and invasion capabilities of ccRCC cell lines. Although the precise functional mechanisms of these core genes in ccRCC are not yet fully elucidated, this study provides new insights for the treatment of ccRCC.
abstract_zh: 透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）是肾细胞癌（RCC）最常见的亚型。尽管随着医学进步，我们在RCC治疗方面取得了诸多成就，但转移性RCC的临床管理仍是一个严峻挑战。SWI/SNF染色质重塑复合物相关基因（SCRGs）与ccRCC中的肿瘤进展和癌细胞演化显著相关。本研究旨在探讨SCRGs在ccRCC中的预后意义，以阐明其分子亚型特征。利用29个已知的SCRGs，将来自TCGA-KIRC队列的532名ccRCC患者分为两个亚型（SCRGcluster A和SCRGcluster B）。与SCRGcluster A相比，SCRGcluster B患者的预后显著较差。功能富集和免疫微环境谱在两个亚型间存在显著差异，其中SCRGcluster B表现出更高的免疫浸润水平。通过整合多种机器学习方法和多变量Cox回归分析，鉴定出五个核心基因（TMCC3、TOP2A、EPS8、PIK3R3、KCNK5）。基于这些核心基因的新型预后模型在外部队列中得到验证。此外，单细胞数据分析揭示了这些核心基因在ccRCC中的表达模式。体外实验表明，KCNK5在ccRCC细胞系和组织中表达下调，其过表达抑制恶性表型。具体而言，KCNK5过表达显著抑制了ccRCC细胞系的增殖、迁移和侵袭能力。尽管这些核心基因在ccRCC中的精确功能机制尚未完全阐明，但本研究为ccRCC的治疗提供了新的见解。
